plain_language_conclusion: 一份人工账户从第一周保存并重启到第二周，固定买单只扣同一份现金；250 元只到账一次，后续买单和费用也各记一次。这个结果只验证合成执行账，不证明真实交易或完整策略。
scope: One artificial fixed-order two-week account; no allocation planner, old adapter lock reset, market/account/production action, or strategy performance inference.

version_and_recovery_guards.original_sources: Verify all three selected original source SHA and fixture before old Ledger import, before each economic operation, and before rebuilding each saved event.
version_and_recovery_guards.wrapper: Save actual cross_week_fixed_orders.py SHA in checkpoint; reject changed executor before Ledger call on continued or restored work.
version_and_recovery_guards.replay: Rebuild a new Ledger from the saved frozen input and events; compare each event result, full Decimal state, audit, cursor and final state before continuing.
version_and_recovery_guards.faults: Synthetic failures before and after atomic state replacement are preserved; restart distinguishes unapplied event from committed event, with no second economic application.

preserved_failures.result: 15 passed, 1 failed: test compared Decimal string trailing zeros instead of amounts
preserved_failures.repair: numeric Decimal comparison; original log retained

preserved_failures.result: AttributeError: 'CompletedProcess' object has no attribute 'pid' after continuous process completed
preserved_failures.repair: read back completed state, use Popen.pid for subsequent new processes; no directory or state overwrite

preserved_failures.result: Original wrapper rechecked source only before import and did not bind wrapper SHA in checkpoint
preserved_failures.repair: preserved v1 state/log/source snapshot, added per-operation and reconstruction source guard plus wrapper version binding, then ran isolated v2

limitations: The preserved v1 source snapshot was taken after v1 processes ran but before version-binding repair; exact new-wrapper bytes at initial v1 process start were not independently hashed at that time. V2 binds the exact executable wrapper SHA.
Artificial flat prices, fixed orders and costs do not establish real market execution, account suitability, P0 allocation, or complete LEI strategy behavior.
Single-writer recovery and synthetic injected failures do not verify concurrent writers, sell orders, partial fills or corporate actions.
